newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiwa Sec seen posting 80 bln yen net loss - paper.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa Sec seen posting 80 bln yen net loss - paper.

text.p: Daiwa Securities Co Ltd is expected to post a parent net loss of about 80 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1997, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Tuesday.
Daiwa Securities officials were not immdiately available for comment.
The securities house posted a parent net profit of 43.69 billion yen in 1995/96.
Daiwa Securities said on Monday that it was sure that it would post a large net loss for the year to March 31, but it did not give a specific forecast.
Daiwa said that due to a sharp fall in share prices in recent months, it cannot expect a sharp rise in its business and cannot raise a large profit from securities sales.
Previously, Daiwa had said it would provide 120 billion yen in support to its finance unit and it would include an extraordinary loss of the same amount in its 1996/97 earnings.
Daiwa had also said it would try not to post a net loss in 1996/97 by selling some holding securities and using reserves.
Daiwa said on Monday it would also cancel its original plan to use reserves for coping with losses.
